title: balenaOS Hostapp Composition
description: Docker Compose v2.4 composition with balena-yocto-scripts x-build extension. See docs/specs/hostapp-composition.md for the contract.

x-build-args.description: Extra barys arguments for the one bitbake invocation that builds every service. The device overlay's list is appended to the meta-balena base list, so the overlay wins on a repeated flag or -a key.

allOf.$comment: An overlay runs under a named OCI runtime.

x-build.description: Build directive for balena-yocto-scripts. Either an object with the build config, or null (~) to opt out of the build while keeping the service in the deployed composition.

recipe.description: Bitbake image target. Omitted for hostapp (falls back to the device type's yocto.image); required for extensions.

assets.description: Globs of raw build outputs relative to the deploy dir root build/tmp/deploy/, uploaded as web resources attached to the balenaCloud release. Use images/__MACHINE__/ (substituted at composition parse time) for machine-specific output, or a build/tmp/deploy/ sibling (e.g. cyclonedx-export/balena-image*/*.json, licenses/**) in place. The globs expand as plain bash globs, so ** matches one directory level, the same as *. The build job transforms these to the flat contract layout: strip images/<machine>/, cyclonedx-export/ -> cyclonedx/, and tar licenses/ -> licenses.tar.gz and rpi-eeprom/secure-boot-lock/ -> secure-boot-lock.tar.gz. The assets of all services attach to one release under flat keys, so the build fails when two different files map to one key. The device overlay's list is appended to the meta-balena base list.
